structured_output.what_is_happening: INCOME ("Mysterious Source of Income") is an 11-minute-old Meteora pool, not a pump.fun launch. Its market cap is about $56-62k with about $50k of liquidity. It has done about $900k of volume, roughly 18x its market cap in its first hour, and the price is up about 450-500%. At least 5 other same-name coins were launched within the same few minutes, all of them tiny or dead. This one is clearly winning the clone race. The meme phrase seems to be tied to a tweet from 'deltasociety'. An older INCOME coin created around August 2026 still exists at about $150k market cap. The creator's wallet holds 0 tokens and GMGN shows its status as 'creator_close'. All of the LP is unlocked and none of it is burned. GMGN flags 58 bundler wallets, which make up about 55% of top traders. There are 1,777 unique buyers but only 72 unique sellers, and those 72 sellers made about 1,885 sell transactions.

narrative.description: A recycled meme phrase, 'mysterious source of income', apparently set off by a specific X post (deltasociety status). It has spawned a flurry of same-name clones launched within minutes of each other.
narrative.why_spreading: A viral phrase or tweet is getting cloned by many deployers, and this pool picked up the most flow. However, an older INCOME coin with the same name already exists, which suggests this meme has been used before and has limited new appeal.

token_connection.why_this_token: Among this batch of launches it has by far the most volume and liquidity, and the most holders at about 1,800. Of the fresh clones it looks like the leader.
token_connection.competing_tokens: An older INCOME (9PSx..., about $150k market cap, $67k liquidity, created about 6 weeks ago) could claim to be the original. There are several fresh clones launched in the same minute (4nvY, 5MZo, ET3W, 1aEV) and an MSI coin launched earlier today. All of the fresh ones are small or have no liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: The 1,777 unique buyers suggest some real breadth. But 58 bundler wallets make up about 55% of top traders, the bot/degen rate is 52%, and a 'top entrapment trader' share of 25% is flagged. Only 72 unique sellers produced about 1,885 sells, which looks like a small group of bots or insiders cycling volume and taking profit into the buyers. There are no paid boosts and no KOL or smart-money wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: Without X data I can't tell whether the source tweet is genuinely going viral.

structural_risks: All of the LP is unlocked on a Meteora pool the creator seeded, so liquidity can be pulled at any time
The creator has already left: balance is 0 and status is 'creator_close'
Heavy bundler presence and a lopsided seller set (72 wallets making about 1,885 sells)
Already up about 5x within 11 minutes, so entry at T+4m comes after the steepest part of the move
Ticker is crowded, including an older same-name coin with more liquidity

structured_output.counterargument: It already has about 1,800 real-looking holders and a $50k liquidity cushion. Mint and freeze authority are renounced and there are no sell taxes. It is clearly winning the clone race around a phrase tied to a tweet. Fresh viral-phrase leaders at about $60k market cap sometimes reach $200-500k within hours, and a 2x from entry needs only about $120-130k. Also, the creator's balance being zero might just mean it was sold at launch, not that a rug is planned.
